text: The authors describe debate (Irving et al., 2018) as another possible approach to training question-answering systems where a human expert cannot evaluate answers directly, and state that both debate and Iterated Amplification involve a recursive structure where AI systems help humans address relevant subquestions.
title: Iterated Amplification vs debate: shared recursive structure
